title: About me

name: Tianyuan “Margaret” Zheng 郑天圆
credentials:
MIT SB ’23, MEng ’24
Phi Beta Kappa, Tau Beta Pi
intro: Hi! My name is Margaret, and I'm an artist/musician/math and economics enjoyer/writer based in Boston, MA. A fun fact about me is that I've never not lived next to the coast. Another fun fact is that I was born on pi day. A third fun fact is that I moved to the U.S. because I fell in love with frozen yogurt. Now what if I told you these were two truths and a lie? (jk, they are all truths as far as I know.)

sections.lead: As an MIT undergraduate, I double majored in course 18 (Math) and course 6-14 (CS/Econ/Data Sci) with a minor in 21M (Music), though I sometimes wished that I had double majored in eating and sleeping instead (like a [certain plump beaver](https://www.widetim.com/about/about-wide-tim) that I draw sometimes).
sections.text:
I stayed at MIT for another year and a master's degree in 6-14, during which I got to do some research on education topics in economics, teach econometrics/game theory, and continue doing art :D

I've loved creating art for as long as I can remember, but it was not until my college years that I finally started to see it as a powerful voice and a game-changer that brightens the world and brings smiles to people’s faces. Because of this, I’ve been actively involved in many of MIT’s public art projects, art organizations, and independently-run STEM and wellness art accounts, sharing the joy of the colorful palettes in my head and hands.

sections.lead: Art makes me happy, but so do many other things: piano improvisation, writing songs, poetry, and stories, exploring random math facts, pondering complexity theory questions, drawing econometrics comics, and baking π without a recipe.
sections.text: It feels like there's as much to life as the cardinalities of infinities, and I’m here for all of it through the rain and shine.

closing: Thank you for visiting this space where I put forth my best efforts to consolidate my interests, hobbies, and projects. If you would like to follow my life in comic form, check out [@marge_z_art](https://www.instagram.com/marge_z_art/) on Instagram!
signoff: HAVE FUN and hope that you are having a great day!
